     │

나머지는 모두 0

import numpy as np

from scipy.stats import multinomial


mu = np.array([
    0.1,
    0.2,
    0.2,
    0.2,
    0.2,
    0.1
])

# One Categorical Trial
rv = multinomial(
    n=1,
    p=mu
)

# 6개의 One-Hot Vector
one_hot_vectors = np.eye(
    6,
    dtype=int
)

probabilities = rv.pmf(
    one_hot_vectors
)

print(probabilities)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

logits = torch.tensor([
    [2.0, 0.5, -1.0],
    [0.1, 0.2, 1.3]
])

targets = torch.tensor(
    [0, 2],
    dtype=torch.long
)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

loss = criterion(
    logits,

)
